test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

Not everything __that happen in natures__ is due to global warming alone.
solution:
The correct answer is: **that happens in nature.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence is grammatically incorrect because ""natures"" should be singular ""nature"". Option 4 corrects this error by using the singular form ""nature"" and the correct verb tense ""happens"".
 
• Option 1 is incorrect because ""happening"" is a gerund and cannot be used as the subject of the sentence.
 
• Option 2 is incorrect because ""natures"" is still plural and the incorrect verb tense ""happens"" is used.
 
• Option 3 is incorrect because the original sentence contains a grammatical error.

Hence, the corrected form of the sentence is: **Not everything* that happens in nature__* is due to global warming alone.**
